en.title: Where the Focus Lies: The Roaring Sea Lighthouse and Our Maintenance
en.premise: A story of the 'lighthouse maintenance technicians' who safeguard the safety of maritime routes. As a newcomer, 'I' question the necessity of continuing to polish aging optical equipment in an era of advanced GPS technology, yet I begin my apprenticeship under seasoned veterans. Perched on desolate rocky shores, the small workshop serves as a 'desert oasis' of tranquility for those working in such harsh conditions. This is a chronicle of the daily struggle against minute distortions of light to restore the brilliance of well-worn Fresnel lenses.

zh.title: 焦点之行方 ——潮汐之灯塔与我们的维护
zh.premise: 这是一个关于守护航道安全的“灯塔维护技师”的故事。身为新人的“我”，在GPS技术普及的当下，一边对为何仍需不断擦拭旧式灯塔光学仪器感到困惑，一边向经验丰富的老师傅们拜师学艺。坐落在荒凉岩岸上的小小工作坊，对于在艰苦环境下工作的他们来说，宛如“沙漠中的绿洲”般宁静。这是一部为了找回陈旧“菲涅耳透镜”的光辉，与微小的光线畸变作斗争的日常记录。
